newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: Swedish debt yields closed marginally higher on Friday following a wave of selling to interbank actors at market close a day earlier. The crown gained slightly against the mark in very thin trade.
"Debt yields were up two to three basis points this morning after interbank dealers had long positions. After that it has been as quiet here as in overseas markets," one dealer said.
Higher U.S. debt yields from Thursday also fuelled gains.
